fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

trait Camera is
    take_photo() => write_line("flash!")
si

trait MobilePhone is
    make_call() => write_line("ring ring")
si

class CAMERA_PHONE: Camera, MobilePhone is
    init() is si
si

let phone = CAMERA_PHONE()

write_line("is a Camera: {isa Camera(phone)}")
write_line("is a MobilePhone: {isa MobilePhone(phone)}")

phone.take_photo()
phone.make_call()
output:
is a Camera: True
is a MobilePhone: True
flash!
ring ring
